notes: ACCESS: HTTP-first tier (a) only - requests + bs4 direct fetch of live pages, robots.txt (Shopify default, User-agent: * Allow: /) permits full crawl, no block encountered, Playwright/Chrome not needed. TREE: Shopify store. Built tree from union of (1) rendered mega-menu in homepage HTML (site-nav__item / megamenu__col structures: top nav = Mirror, Storage, Furniture>[Chairs & Stools, Shoe Cabinet, Other Furniture], Lighting, Wall Art>[canvases, Wall Shelves, Clocks], Shop All>[Decor>(Artifacts, Home Improvement, Fountain, Planters, Faux Plants, Globes, Furnishing, Laundry Baskets, Storage), Kitchen+Bar>(...), Wall Art>(...), Lighting, Furniture], Clearance (promotional, excluded)) and (2) sitemap_collections_1.xml (270 collection slugs) filtered for storage/textile keywords, cross-checked against live nav. Each candidate leaf was fetched directly and its H1/canonical verified to match the requested slug (no silent parent-total substitution observed). QTY: exact 'N products' text from the rendered collection header (Shopify theme prints 'N products' near the Filter/Sort controls); confirmed this is the true collection count (not a decoy) by noting that the 2 grid-product cards appearing on every page, including the zero-count ones, are a 'Cosmos and Chaos Canvas' + 'TerraDry Stone Bath Mat' recommendation widget unrelated to the collection's own contents. EXCLUDED: Rugs/Curtains/Bed Linen/Placemats and Table Linen/Bed Sheets/Soft Furniture kept (qty=0, genuine site collection pages with matching H1, currently empty - recorded per zero-product-category convention, not fabricated). Pouffes & Floor Cushions (4) and Stools & Leg-Rests (3) excluded from Textile despite 'Cushions' in the name - the actual listed products are pouffes/stools (Bohemian Dreamscape Lace Pouffe, Furry Lox Shaggy Stool, Plush Perch Stool, CosyFold Portable Velvet Pouffe) i.e. furniture/seating, not textile cushion products (textile.md SS21 Ottoman-is-Furniture example). Shoe Cabinet (8) and Other Furniture (9, incl. TierTwist-Rotating Organizer/WhiteBarn Sideboard/Slot Freestanding Cabinet) excluded from Storage because the live mega-menu explicitly nests them under the Furniture top-nav item (storage.md SS21/SS27: prefer Furniture when the site explicitly places the product inside a Furniture category). Shoe Organisers (6) kept in Storage at MEDIUM confidence - it is a sitemap-only page (not reachable from the live mega-menu) whose products meaningfully overlap with the Furniture-nav Shoe Cabinet page, but its own H1 'Shoe Organisers' and product titles (Shoe Organizer Cabinet x N) match storage.md SS7/SS10 Organizers/Shoe-Storage and it is not itself nested under the Furniture nav node, so it was kept as a distinct genuine category rather than dropped as a duplicate. Also excluded as out-of-scope for both categories: Mirror, Chairs & Stools, Lighting, Wall Art and its sub-canvases/Wall Shelves/Clocks/Metal & Resin Wall Art/Mirrors, Decor/Artifacts/Home Improvement/Fountain/Planters/Faux Plants/Globes, Kitchen+Bar and its glassware/barware/Kitchen subcategories, Gift Box, Serving Trays, Napkin Holders, all Clearance/seasonal/promotional collections (per View-All/Collections exclusion rule).
